svg.title: LAN Video Player
svg.desc: Browse and play videos from a PC or NAS over SMB on phones and tablets, with subtitles, resume, and watch history. No copying, no transcoding server. SMB 2/3 access via smbj, with no companion service on the PC / Media3 by default, falling back to libVLC when it cannot decode / Share credentials encrypted on device; logs redacted before output
